title: What's New: Draft Page for Electronic Invoices (2025 release wave 2)

chapters.title: Workflow comparison: old vs new draft page approach
New draft page features and matching capabilities

features.name: Draft page for electronic invoices
features.description: New draft page functionality for electronic invoice processing that allows users to review, refine, and edit incoming documents before posting, with support for editing quantities, prices, units of measure, and vendor information.
features.status_evidence_quote: This functionality will be in a public preview.
caveats: Only one setup can be used at a time - cannot use both old and new draft page features simultaneously
Will not be available in October 2025, coming in a later minor release
Users should test in sandbox before production use

features.name: Item reference mapping
features.description: Automatic matching of invoice lines to items using configured item references, with visual indicators showing how the mapping was completed and ability to navigate to the source item reference configuration.
caveats: Depends on proper item reference setup configuration

features.name: Text to account mapping
features.description: Configuration option for mapping text descriptions from invoices to general ledger accounts, used as one of the matching strategies before AI fallback.

features.name: Historical line matching
features.description: When invoice lines cannot be matched using item references or text mapping, the system looks at previously posted invoices from the same vendor to find similar lines and use their account mapping.
caveats: Only works if historical purchase invoices exist for the vendor

features.name: AI fallback for account identification
features.description: When item references, text mapping, and historical matching fail, AI is used as a fallback to identify and suggest appropriate general ledger accounts for invoice lines, with explanations of the suggestion.
caveats: Uses AI which may not always be accurate and requires user review

features.name: Editable invoice lines in draft
features.description: All invoice lines in the draft page are fully editable, allowing users to change quantities, prices, units of measure, descriptions, type and number fields before posting.

features.name: Vendor correction in draft
features.description: Users can edit and change the vendor on an invoice line in the draft page if the system fails to automatically identify the correct vendor based on VAT number or name and address matching.

features.name: E-document service version 2
features.description: New version of e-document service configuration that supports the draft page workflow for electronic invoice processing with version-based setup selection.
caveats: Cannot be used simultaneously with version 1 processing
